headline: Santander says AI initiatives generate 194 million euros in business value
body: Spanish bank Santander said AI initiatives generated 194 million euros ($216 million) in business value in the first nine months of 2026. Its CFO, José García Cantera, told CNBC that AI is helping the bank reduce low-value tasks so employees can focus on higher-value work.
note: Cantera said it is hard to separate how much of the bank's results come from AI, so the figure is a useful signal for finance teams tracking payback but not a clean return on investment.

figure.label: AI business value, first nine months of 2026, per Santander

evidence.text: Spanish banking giant Santander said Wednesday that it saw AI initiatives generate 194 million euros ($216 million) in business value in the first nine months of 2026 .
Santander Chief Financial Officer José García Cantera told CNBC that AI is helping the bank reduce low-value tasks so employees can focus on higher-value work.

AI is being embedded in all the processes that we are conducting at the bank, so it's really difficult to just say how much comes from AI, but clearly AI is improving the quality of our services to clients.
